context.purpose: Author bounded editable RGBA pixel sprites, layers, timed frames and tags, then publish native sprites, previews and sheet metadata. Import captured RGBA8 PNG artwork into editable cels with exact pixel placement.
context.assumptions: Aseprite 1.3.x batch Lua API; integer pixel coordinates, explicit RGBA bytes and millisecond frame durations. Layer and frame identifiers must already exist.
context.constraints: Only captured metadata-free RGBA8 noninterlaced PNG imports, binary alpha and complete in-canvas replacement. No arbitrary Lua, general formats, scaling, clipping or blending. Canvas/frame/palette limits apply; flattened PNGs lose editable layers.
context.inspection: Inspect PNG pixels and sheet rectangles/durations alongside native layer/frame readback. Use image and retained text evidence; no native live editing hook.
context.recovery: Correct selection, layer/frame and out-of-canvas faults before execution. Configure a real batch-capable Aseprite executable; preserve native logs and rerun in a fresh directory.

lifecycle.timeout: Each native process is bounded by the runner timeout; conformance adds an independent wall-clock watchdog.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process cancellation retains partial evidence. Pre-launch cancellation is tested separately from shared in-flight cleanup.
lifecycle.logs: Fresh run directory retains authored input, effective plan, native submissions/stdout/stderr, publications and verification evidence.
lifecycle.verification: An independent host raster model checks native reopened layers, frame durations, RGBA pixels, sheet metadata and all publication hashes.
